title: Augmentation compatibility after transport through the source alpha isomorphism
statement: Let $f:X\prime\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open cover of $X$, $U\prime$ an arbitrary family of opens of $X\prime$, and $c$ a specified index map with $U\prime_i\subset f^{-1}(U_{c(i)})$. Let $F$ be a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], $p\geq0$, and $\gamma$ a cochain map with the prescribed tuple formula [def-sc-cech-refinement-cochain-map]. Assume enough injectives for the module categories and additivity of global sections. Let $D$ be any resolution data [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] for the tensor-pullback adjunction unit: resolutions $D.J$ of $F$ and $D.I$ of $f^*F$, an injective complex $D.K$, a quasi-isomorphism $\lambda:f_*D.I\to D.K$, an augmented lift $b:D.J\to D.K$, and the pinned sections comparison $a$. Put $r=e_J^{-1}H(\Gamma b)H(a\Gamma\lambda)^{-1}e_I$, where $e_J,e_I$ are the forgetting-scalars homology identifications. Write $a=H^p(\alpha_U)$ and $a\prime=H^p(\alpha_{U\prime})$, after forgetting scalars. The covering condition on $U$ makes $a$ invertible. For the explicitly constructed map $t=a^{-1}r a\prime$, the augmentation equation $H^p(\beta_U)t=H^p(\gamma)H^p(\beta_{U\prime})$ holds. This statement asserts only augmentation compatibility for this fixed map, not existence of a map satisfying two squares.

proof.text: Form the four Cech double complexes B, B-prime, B-double-prime and A of Tag 01FD using D.J, D.K, the pushforward of D.I and D.I. The maps are induced by D.beta, D.lambda, and the prescribed tuplewise pullback/restriction formula. Functoriality and restriction naturality verify the two chain directions and total signs.

For every intersection of source opens, sections of D.lambda are a quasi-isomorphism, by acyclicity of pushforwards of injectives and of injectives. Apply the first-quadrant total column comparison (with transposition to place resolution columns correctly) to obtain an invertible map on total homology B-double-prime -> B-prime. Compose the map from B to B-prime, this inverse, and the refinement map to A to construct t.

The augmentation compatibility equation in D makes the pentagon commute; its tuplewise formula is hgamma. Take homology and transport through forgetting scalars to obtain H(beta_B) composed with t = H(gamma) composed with H(beta_A). Restriction naturality gives the global-section squares. The pinned section comparison D.a identifies global sections of D.I and of its pushforward. Inverting the global-sections map of D.lambda gives exactly the displayed raw sections map r and hence the second square.

The restriction squares and D.sections identify the zigzag map's alpha composite with r followed by target alpha. Source alpha is invertible by def-sc-module-cech-comparison. Cancel it to identify that map with the displayed fixed map, and substitute into the augmentation equation.

    {ι ι' : Type v} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤)
    (U' : ι' → X'.Opens)
    (refine : ι' → ι) (hrefine : ∀ i, U' i ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U (refine i))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    [EnoughInjectives X.Modules] [EnoughInjectives X'.Modules]
    [(RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).Additive]
    [(RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X'.toRingedSpace).Additive] (p : ℕ)
    (gamma : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat) ⟶
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X', ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          ((cechComplexFunctor U').obj ((tensorPullback f).obj F).presheafModuleCat))
    (hgamma : IsCechRefinementMap f U U' refine hrefine F gamma)
    (D : ModuleCohomologyFMapData f F ((tensorPullback f).obj F)
      ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app F)) :
    let r := (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex D.J).sc p).mapHomologyIso
        (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat)).inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace ⋙
          forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map D.β) p ≫
      inv (I := D.invertible p) (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (D.a.hom ≫
        ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace ⋙
          forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map D.lambda) p) ≫
      (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex D.I).sc p).mapHomologyIso
        (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat)).hom
    letI := moduleCechAlpha_isIso U hU D.J p
    let t := (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat).map
        (inv (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechAlpha U D.J) p)) ≫ r ≫
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X', ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat).map
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechAlpha U' D.I) p)
    (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat).map
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechBeta U D.J) p) ≫ t =
      cechRefinementHomology gamma p ≫
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X', ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat).map
          (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechBeta U' D.I) p)
